## Handoff and review

- [ ] Owning public docs/contracts match the implementation.
- [ ] Accepted-spec conflicts have an informed resolution; per-criterion implementation/evidence, remaining gaps and a resume checkpoint are recorded under the shared specification rule.
- [ ] Prepared private Knowledge handoff covers all paired PRs at their latest heads.
- [ ] Relevant checks and final-revision review findings are addressed.
- [ ] Merge is authorized and actual GitHub requirements are satisfied; human review is optional.
- [ ] After merge: finalize Knowledge with actual merge SHAs and confirm that update is merged.
- [ ] Integration claims verify the intended base/actual merge reachability; a feature-branch merge is not reported as main delivery.
